analysis: Certified re-test after the Historian's audit - an exact embedding filter (circle product as multiplication in Z[x]/(characteristic polynomial)) and explicit failing triples. Certified thresholds (largest failing shift / first shift without a failure found) - Fibonacci 1/2, Pell 0/1, (2,2;1,2) 5/6, tribonacci 3/4, 4-bonacci 7/8, G(k+1) = G(k) + G(k-2) 10/11, (3,3;1,5) 9/10. Upper values are 'no failure found', not proofs. Of the 90 quadratic rows of EXP-C08-04, 6 had certified-failing 'associative' shifts; 10 remain non-monotone, none with beta > 0.

methodology: For every sequence and shift: test the embedding identity on the pair set; on the first failing pair search an explicit triple; record a certified counterexample or 'no failure found'.
question: Which associativity claims of EXP-C08-02..04 survive a stronger search (embedding identity on all pairs a <= b < 200, 2000 random pairs below 10^6, the literature example of Ambroz-Frougny-Masakova-Pelantova for tribonacci), with explicit counterexamples for every failure?
